config_ini:
# Original full-game training plus FPG practice, sharing the semantic encoder.
# See ocean/mario_sim/FPG.md. Starts follow a real successful ROM route.
# Full-playfield semantic CNN + player/object branches; old RAM weights cannot load.
# Baseline: 90M sweep run 126 (sweep_1791715536141_0126), trained fresh below.
[base]
env_name = mario_sim
# Fresh weights and curriculum for training/sweeps; pass a path to resume.
load_model_path = None
# Keep periodic recovery weights without filling the disk during 2B-step trials.
checkpoint_interval = 1024
eval_episodes = 0
async = 1
cudagraphs = 1
seed = 73
reset_every_horizon = 0

[vec]
total_agents = 4096
num_buffers = 4
num_threads = 12
num_policies = 1

[policy]
hidden_size = 256
num_layers = 2

# One shared semantic policy; modes: game, fpg, mixed.
[env]
mode = mixed
seed = 73
engine_module = build/mario_sim/runtime/cuda_replay.cubin
engine_cpu_archive = build/mario_sim/runtime/logic_cpu.a

# Natural starts, uniform over the original 32 stages. -1 selects all stages;
# 0 starts at 1-1, 31 at 8-4. Clears and life losses continue naturally.
[game]
reset_bank = build/mario_sim/runtime/generated/bank.bin
fixed_stage = -1
max_frames = 108000
terminate_on_clear = 0
clear_reward = 1
# Reward each 128 newly traversed rightward pixels (8 tiles).
# Frontiers persist across lives; backtracking and pipe teleports do not pay.
checkpoint_distance = 128
checkpoint_reward = 0.025
time_bonus = 0.1
time_target_frames = 1800
death_penalty = 0

# Fixed actor allocation: fraction of frames in mixed mode, rounded to actors.
[fpg]
fraction = 0.25
reset_bank = build/mario_sim/fpg/curriculum/bank.bin
max_frames = 1800
fixed_stage = 0
world_variants = 1
# All states come from actual ROM gameplay, with no synthetic RAM edits.
generation_knobs = 0
# Each actor advances one band after two qualifying windows of frontier episodes.
# Easier practice episodes do not count toward promotion. Failure stays put.
curriculum = 1
curriculum_adaptive = 1
curriculum_start_frames = 3
curriculum_window = 16
curriculum_confirmations = 2
curriculum_threshold = 0.8
curriculum_replay = 0.2
# Preserve actor progress in a sidecar with each checkpoint; 0 starts it afresh.
curriculum_resume = 0
# Evaluation is always fixed. 0 uses the checkpoint's median frontier.
curriculum_eval_frames = 0
# Every reset has a verified successful continuation; this table is required.
time_table = build/mario_sim/fpg/curriculum_targets.bin
# Success: 1 + time_bonus * min(1, target / actual_frames)^time_power.
# Failure: 0. Set time_bonus=0 for the sparse-reward comparison.
# target = time_target_scale * estimate + time_slack_frames.
time_bonus = 0.1
time_target_scale = 1.0
time_slack_frames = 8
time_power = 1
time_fallback_speed = 2.5
time_fallback_setup = 24

[train]
total_timesteps = 2000000000
learning_rate = 0.00119880412
anneal_lr = 0
gamma = 0.997373044
gae_lambda = 0.994975209
replay_ratio = 1.17733753
clip_coef = 0.602671206
vf_coef = 1.47304153
vf_clip_coef = 1.52212656
# Preserve the timing bonus instead of clipping every success back to 1.
reward_clip = 0
max_grad_norm = 0.346822113
ent_coef = 0.00001
anneal_ent_coef = 0
momentum = 0.869517028
minibatch_size = 2048
horizon = 64
vtrace = 0
vtrace_rho_clip = 4
vtrace_c_clip = 0.924374104
gpus = 1

# Native training-progress sweep; ROM checks are separate from hyperparameter search.
[sweep]
# 75% scaled game pixels + 25% scaled FPG curriculum advancement.
metric = sweep_score
metric_distribution = linear
goal = maximize
max_runs = 128
gpus = 1
downsample = 1
# Scale the proposal cost allowance with the longer 2B trial budget (seconds).
max_suggestion_cost = 54000
max_failures = 1000
worker_path = None
trainer_path = puffer

# The trainer rounds the requested 2B budget down to complete rollouts.
[sweep.train.total_timesteps]
distribution = log_normal
min = 2000000000
max = 2000000000
scale = time

# All ten highest-scoring 90M trials used 4096 actors; keep buffers/threads at 4/12.
[sweep.vec.total_agents]
distribution = uniform_pow2
min = 4096
max = 4096
scale = auto

# Nine of the top ten used width 256. Keep run 126's architecture fixed.
# These defaults target the Vast GPU; the baseline used about 5GB of VRAM.
[sweep.policy.hidden_size]
distribution = uniform_pow2
min = 256
max = 256
scale = auto

[sweep.policy.num_layers]
distribution = int_uniform
min = 2
max = 2
scale = auto

[sweep.train.horizon]
distribution = uniform_pow2
min = 64
max = 1024
scale = auto

[sweep.train.minibatch_size]
distribution = uniform_pow2
min = 1024
max = 16384
scale = auto

# Broad PPO/Muon ranges follow config/default.ini (Breakout/Craftax/NMMO).
[sweep.train.learning_rate]
distribution = log_normal
min = 0.0001
max = 1.0
scale = 0.5

[sweep.train.ent_coef]
distribution = log_normal
min = 0.00001
max = 0.1
scale = auto

[sweep.train.gamma]
distribution = logit_normal
min = 0.8
max = 0.9999
scale = auto

[sweep.train.gae_lambda]
distribution = logit_normal
min = 0.2
max = 0.999
scale = auto

[sweep.train.replay_ratio]
distribution = uniform
min = 0.25
max = 4.0
scale = auto

[sweep.train.clip_coef]
distribution = uniform
min = 0.1
max = 0.9
scale = auto

[sweep.train.vf_clip_coef]
distribution = uniform
min = 0.01
max = 5.0
scale = auto

[sweep.train.vf_coef]
distribution = uniform
min = 0.1
max = 4.0
scale = auto

[sweep.train.max_grad_norm]
distribution = uniform
min = 0.1
max = 1.5
scale = auto

[sweep.train.momentum]
distribution = logit_normal
min = 0.5
max = 0.999
scale = auto

# Optional off-policy correction for the one-rollout-lag async actor.
# c <= rho for every sampled combination. Clips apply only with vtrace=1.
[sweep.train.vtrace]
distribution = int_uniform
min = 0
max = 1
scale = auto

[sweep.train.vtrace_rho_clip]
distribution = uniform
min = 1
max = 4
scale = auto

[sweep.train.vtrace_c_clip]
distribution = uniform
min = 0.1
max = 1
scale = auto
